faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the HAL Visiting Consultant (Neuro Surgeon) recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application for the HAL Visiting Consultant (Neuro Surgeon) recruitment is 30th September 2026. Ensure your application reaches the designated address before this date.

faq.question: Q2. What are the essential qualifications for the Visiting Consultant (Neuro Surgeon) post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess an MBBS degree along with an MS and MCH in Neuro Surgery to be eligible for the Visiting Consultant (Neuro Surgeon) position.

faq.question: Q3. Is there any application fee for this HAL recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this HAL recruitment. Candidates can apply without paying any fee.
